headline: Houthi missiles and drones kept coming at Saudi Arabia: the Houthis claim hits on the East-West pipeline and Riyadh airport (Oct 26, not confirmed, #1350); the coalition says it intercepted two missiles over Riyadh on Oct 29 with no casualties reported (#1351), and more drones and a missile on Oct 30-31 (#1352, #1354).
Inside Yemen the Houthis fired two missiles at the presidential palace in Aden on Oct 30, a police official says; no casualty figures were given (#1353).

No US move against the Houthis was found this week: no strike, sanctions, naval action, posture change or talks. The last US strike on the Houthis is still before the May 6, 2025 ceasefire (#1319), and the last Treasury round was Jan 16, 2026 (#1329).
No Houthi attack on US forces or on non-Saudi shipping was found this week.
pending: Whether the US joins the Saudi strikes (#1341); no decision found by Nov 2
